```{r, include = F}
source(here::here("scripts/00_source.R"))
```

```{r}
#load the fasta file to creata a table with these columns: UPID	nucleotides	marker-codes	species_name	order_name	data

fasta   <- read.fasta(here::here("data/raw_data/ANML.fasta"), seqtype = "DNA", as.string = TRUE)


df_part1 <- tibble(
  UPID          = names(fasta),
  nucleotides   = map_chr(fasta, ~ paste0(.x, collapse = "")),
  `marker-codes`= "COI-5P",              # adjust if needed‐dataset
  data          = "OHIA"                 # e.g. your project code
) |> 
  left_join(
  taxonomy_df |> select(zotu_id, order_name= order, species_name = species),
  by = c("UPID" = "zotu_id")) |> 
  select(UPID, nucleotides, `marker-codes`, species_name, order_name, data) |>
  drop_na(order_name)

df_hdim <- 
  read_csv(here::here("data/raw_data/HDIM_beating_niclassify.csv")) |>
  mutate(data = "HDIM") 


df_checklist <- 
  read.xlsx(here::here("data/raw_data/2025-05-24_checklist_V1.xlsx"), sheet = "checklist_V1") |>
    select(nucleotides = sequence,
           species_name = species,
           order_name = order,
         status_simple, ) |> 
  filter(nucleotides != "NA") |>
  filter(status_simple == "INTRODUCED" | status_simple == "NATIVE") |>
  mutate(`marker-codes` = "COI-5P",.after = nucleotides) |>
  mutate(data = "Checklist") |> 
  mutate(UPID = paste0("C_",row_number()),.before =nucleotides) 

#create two fasta files from hdim and checklist to load into NIClassify


# 1) bind & clean (drop any NA/empty seqs)
df_all <- bind_rows(df_checklist, df_hdim, df_part1) 

write.csv(df_all, here("NIClassify/01_NIClassify.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")

df_all <- bind_rows(df_checklist, df_hdim, df_part1) %>%
  transmute(
    id  = UPID,
    seq = str_remove_all(as.character(nucleotides), "\\s+")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(seq) & seq != "")
          
          
# 2) build a list of sequence‐strings
seq_list <- setNames(as.list(df_all$seq), df_all$id)

# 3) write combined FASTA
write.fasta(
  sequences = seq_list,
  names     = names(seq_list),
  file.out  = here("NIClassify/00_NIClassify.fasta"),
  as.string = TRUE
)

```


After running the features in NIClassify we need to use our checklist again to merge the status
```{r}

#lead NIClassify feature results

feature_niclassify <- read_csv(here("output/NIClassify_features.csv")) 

checklist_status <- df_all |> 
  select(UPID, status_simple) 


```
